meta.title: Normandy → Brittany · Cycle Tour 2025
meta.lede: Eleven days from the D-Day beaches to Roscoff, by way of Mont-Saint-Michel, Saint-Malo and the Breton coast, with ferries and trains at either end.
meta.description: An interactive map and journal of a September 2025 bike tour from Ouistreham to Roscoff.
